title: The News
tagline: Headlines, prices, politics and the passive voice.
canDo: You can follow the gist of an Urdu news bulletin and talk about it

grammar.title: The passive
grammar.body: Past form + jana: ailaan kiya gaya (it was announced), faisla kiya gaya (it was decided), bataya gaya hai ke… (it has been said that…). The verb agrees with the thing: ailaan (m.) kiya gaya, baat (f.) ki gayi.

grammar.title: X mein izafa / kami
grammar.body: qeemat mein izafa (a rise in price), bijli ki qeemat mein kami (a fall in the price of electricity). News prefers these nouns to the everyday verbs barhna and kam hona.

grammar.title: -tareen: the most
grammar.body: taaza tareen (latest), behtareen (best), bad-tareen (worst), aham tareen (most important). A Persian superlative that everyday Urdu also uses.

grammar.title: ke mutabiq
grammar.body: zaraye ke mutabiq (according to sources), hukumat ke mutabiq (according to the government), Nani ke mutabiq (according to Nani: the most reliable).

phrases.en: a rise in the price of petrol

phrases.urdu: حکومت نے نئے بجٹ کا اعلان کیا

hukumat ne naye budget ka ailan kiya

phrases.roman: naye budget ka ailaan kiya gaya
phrases.urdu: نئے بجٹ کا اعلان کیا گیا
accept: naye budget ka elaan kiya gaya
naye budget ka ailan kiya gaya

phrases.en: There's a chance of rain tomorrow

accept: pakistan ne match jeet liya hai

phrases.roman: Suno suno! Petrol ki qeemat mein phir izafa
phrases.urdu: سنو سنو! پٹرول کی قیمت میں پھر اضافہ
phrases.en: Listen, listen! Another rise in the price of petrol
phrases.speaker: abbu

phrases.roman: Aur tankhwah mein? Us mein kab izafa hoga?
phrases.urdu: اور تنخواہ میں؟ اس میں کب اضافہ ہو گا؟

phrases.speaker: ammi

phrases.roman: Mausam ka haal: kal barish ka imkaan hai
phrases.urdu: موسم کا حال: کل بارش کا امکان ہے
phrases.en: The weather report: a chance of rain tomorrow
phrases.speaker: bilal

phrases.roman: Mere ghutne pehle hi bata chuke hain
phrases.urdu: میرے گھٹنے پہلے ہی بتا چکے ہیں

phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Zaraye ke mutabiq, do ghante mein aayegi
phrases.urdu: ذرائع کے مطابق، دو گھنٹے میں آئے گی
phrases.en: According to sources, it'll be back in two hours
phrases.speaker: khala

phrases.roman: Khabrein suni? Petrol ki qeemat mein phir izafa!
phrases.urdu: خبریں سنیں؟ پٹرول کی قیمت میں پھر اضافہ!
phrases.en: Heard the news? Petrol's gone up again!
phrases.speaker: abbu

phrases.roman: Ji, mehngai bohat barh gayi hai
phrases.urdu: جی، مہنگائی بہت بڑھ گئی ہے
phrases.en: Yes, prices have gone up a lot
accept: ji mehngai bohat barh gayi hai
ji mehngai bohat badh gayi hai

phrases.en: Exactly. And the public are worried
phrases.speaker: abbu

phrases.roman: Yahi to main poochh raha hoon! Tees saal se poochh raha hoon!
phrases.urdu: یہی تو میں پوچھ رہا ہوں! تیس سال سے پوچھ رہا ہوں!
phrases.en: That's what I'm asking! I've been asking for thirty years!
phrases.speaker: abbu

phrases.roman: Achha, koi achhi khabar bhi hai?
phrases.urdu: اچھا، کوئی اچھی خبر بھی ہے؟
phrases.en: Right, is there any good news?
phrases.speaker: abbu

phrases.roman: Ji haan! Pakistan ne match jeet liya
phrases.urdu: جی ہاں! پاکستان نے میچ جیت لیا
accept: ji haan pakistan ne match jeet liya

phrases.roman: Mausam ka haal: kal barish ka imkaan hai
phrases.urdu: موسم کا حال: کل بارش کا امکان ہے
phrases.en: The weather report: a chance of rain tomorrow
accept: mausam ka haal kal barish ka imkaan hai

phrases.roman: Wah! Yeh hui na baat. Mithai mangwao!
phrases.urdu: واہ! یہ ہوئی نا بات۔ مٹھائی منگواؤ!
phrases.en: Ha! Now that's more like it. Order sweets!
phrases.speaker: abbu

phrases.roman: Barish? Phir to bijli zaroor jayegi
phrases.urdu: بارش؟ پھر تو بجلی ضرور جائے گی
phrases.en: Rain? Then the electricity will definitely go
phrases.speaker: abbu

phrases.roman: Tum to ab khabrein bhi samajhte ho. Remote tum rakho
phrases.urdu: تم تو اب خبریں بھی سمجھتے ہو۔ ریموٹ تم رکھو
phrases.en: So you understand the news now too. You keep the remote
phrases.speaker: abbu

phrases.roman: Sab TV ke saamne baith gaye.
phrases.urdu: سب ٹی وی کے سامنے بیٹھ گئے۔
phrases.en: Everyone sat down in front of the TV.

phrases.roman: Khabar yeh thi: petrol ki qeemat mein kami.
phrases.urdu: خبر یہ تھی: پٹرول کی قیمت میں کمی۔
phrases.en: The news was: a fall in the price of petrol.

phrases.roman: Do rupay? Is mein to aadha samosa bhi nahin aata.
phrases.urdu: دو روپے؟ اس میں تو آدھا سموسہ بھی نہیں آتا۔
phrases.en: Two rupees? That won't even buy half a samosa.
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Abbu ne TV band kiya aur kaha: siyasat!
phrases.urdu: ابو نے ٹی وی بند کیا اور کہا: سیاست!
phrases.en: Abbu switched off the TV and said: politics!

teach.title: News Urdu is formal Urdu
teach.info: The news uses the Arabic and Persian end of the vocabulary: hukumat, not sarkar; awaam, not log; taaza tareen, not nayi. The grammar is the grammar you know. It's the nouns that are new.

teach.tip: -tareen makes a superlative: taaza (fresh) → taaza tareen (freshest). behtareen = best.

teach.tip: X mein izafa: a rise in X. The noun for 'more'.
X mein kami: a fall in X. The noun for 'less'.
English words, entirely Pakistani meaning. Everyone knows their neighbourhood's schedule by heart.

teach.title: The passive: kiya gaya
teach.info: News avoids saying who did it. Active: hukumat ne ailaan kiya (the government announced). Passive: ailaan kiya gaya (it was announced). The recipe: past form + gaya/gayi/gaye.

teach.tip: X ke mutabiq: according to X. zaraye = sources.
imkaan = possibility. From the same root as mumkin (possible).

exercises.question: How did Nani already know about the rain?

options.feedback: Bilal is the one being upstaged here.

exercises.prompt: Who did it? Or was it just ‘done’?
exercises.explain: kiya gaya, diya gaya, kaha gaya: the doer has left the sentence.
The passive needs gaya: ailaan kiya gaya.

boss.title: The Nine O'Clock News
boss.blurb: Abbu watches the news at full volume and wants someone to agree with him.
